name: BASIC Workspace numeric arrays and bounded control v1

implementation.workspace_model: canonical lossless tokens with derived semantic indexes
implementation.execution_transport: BWM1-BWM5 supported by worker; campaign uses direct structured projection

guaranteed.numeric_type: IEEE-754 binary64 double at the MIR ABI boundary; arguments and returned results must be finite
guaranteed.condition_truth: zero is false; any nonzero numeric value is true
guaranteed.function_calls: same projected module only; numeric functions; maximum six arguments

local_arrays.index_conversion: truncate toward zero, then check bounds

module_arrays.initial_value: MIR module data zero-initialized; optional designated MIR initializer runs once per persistent worker instance

guaranteed.program_revision: execution projection binds to requested committed revision; edits do not hot-reload existing persistent instances

implementation_dependent.arithmetic_rounding: MIR/native host implementation of double operations; exact bitwise reproducibility across CPU/toolchain is not promised
implementation_dependent.division_by_zero: native double operation may produce a non-finite value; non-finite result is rejected by the host execution API
implementation_dependent.source_rendering: diagnostic/export representation; it is not used by the compiler path

strings.invalid_utf8: rejected at the Python/UTF-8 encoding boundary
strings.string_operations: general concatenation and broad builtin coverage unsupported
